name: Active Scanning
description: Probing victim infrastructure to gather information for targeting

name: Gather Victim Host Information
description: Gathering information about victim hosts such as hardware, software, and configurations

name: Gather Victim Identity Information
description: Gathering victim identity information such as credentials and email addresses

name: Gather Victim Network Information
description: Gathering victim network information such as IP addresses, domain properties, and topology

name: Network Service Scanning
description: Scanning for running services on remote hosts to identify attack surfaces

name: System Information Discovery
description: Collecting detailed information about the operating system and hardware

name: File and Directory Discovery
description: Enumerating files and directories to find sensitive data

name: Network Share Discovery
description: Looking for shared drives and folders on remote systems

name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
description: Exploiting vulnerabilities in internet-facing applications

name: External Remote Services
description: Leveraging external-facing remote services for initial access

name: Valid Accounts
description: Using legitimate credentials for unauthorized access

name: Drive-by Compromise
description: Gaining access through users visiting compromised websites

name: Supply Chain Compromise
description: Manipulating products or delivery mechanisms before receipt by end consumer

name: Trusted Relationship
description: Breaching organizations through trusted third-party relationships

name: Phishing
description: Sending messages to gain access via malicious attachments or links

name: Spearphishing Attachment
description: Sending targeted emails with malicious file attachments

name: Spearphishing Link
description: Sending targeted emails with malicious URLs

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
description: Executing commands via scripting interpreters such as PowerShell or Bash

name: PowerShell
description: Using PowerShell for command execution and script-based attacks

name: Windows Command Shell
description: Using the Windows command shell for command execution

name: Cloud API
description: Abusing cloud APIs for unauthorized operations

name: Scheduled Task/Job
description: Scheduling tasks for persistent or deferred execution

name: Scheduled Task
description: Creating scheduled tasks for persistence or deferred execution

name: System Services
description: Abusing system services for code execution

name: Service Execution
description: Executing malicious code by creating or manipulating Windows services

name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution
description: Configuring programs to execute automatically at boot or logon

name: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
description: Adding programs to registry run keys or startup folders for persistence

name: Create or Modify System Process
description: Creating or modifying system-level processes for persistence

name: Windows Service
description: Creating or modifying Windows services for persistence

name: Create Account
description: Creating new accounts to maintain access

name: Local Account
description: Creating a local account for persistence on compromised systems

name: Account Manipulation
description: Manipulating account properties to maintain and escalate access

name: Rootkit
description: Using rootkits to hide the presence of programs and malicious activity

name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
description: Bypassing access controls to gain elevated privileges

name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
description: Exploiting software vulnerabilities to gain elevated privileges

name: Process Injection
description: Injecting code into running processes to evade defenses or escalate privileges

name: Dynamic-link Library Injection
description: Injecting DLLs into processes for privilege escalation or evasion

name: Access Token Manipulation
description: Manipulating access tokens to operate under different security contexts

name: Impair Defenses
description: Disabling or modifying security tools and defensive mechanisms

name: Disable or Modify Tools
description: Disabling security tools to evade detection

name: Obfuscated Files or Information
description: Making files or information difficult to discover or analyze

name: Indicator Removal
description: Deleting or modifying artifacts to remove evidence of activity

name: Clear Windows Event Logs
description: Clearing Windows event logs to remove evidence of intrusion

name: DLL Side-Loading
description: Hijacking the DLL search order to load malicious libraries

name: Multi-Factor Authentication Bypass
description: Bypassing multi-factor authentication mechanisms

name: Brute Force
description: Attempting to gain access through systematic credential guessing

name: OS Credential Dumping
description: Dumping credentials from the operating system for reuse

name: Network Sniffing
description: Sniffing network traffic to capture credentials and sensitive data

name: Pass the Hash
description: Using stolen password hashes to authenticate without cracking

name: Kerberoasting
description: Requesting Kerberos service tickets to crack offline

name: Adversary-in-the-Middle
description: Positioning between network entities to intercept and manipulate traffic

name: Remote Services
description: Using remote services such as SSH or RDP to move laterally

name: Lateral Tool Transfer
description: Transferring tools between compromised systems within the network

name: Exploitation of Remote Services
description: Exploiting remote service vulnerabilities to move to other systems

name: SSH Hijacking
description: Hijacking existing SSH sessions for unauthorized lateral movement

name: Input Capture
description: Capturing user input including keystrokes and credentials

name: Screen Capture
description: Capturing screen contents for reconnaissance or data collection

name: Clipboard Data
description: Collecting data stored in the clipboard for sensitive information

name: Automated Collection
description: Using automated scripts to collect internal data of interest

name: Archive Collected Data
description: Compressing or encrypting collected data before exfiltration

name: Archive via Utility
description: Using standard utilities to compress collected data

name: Application Layer Protocol
description: Using standard application layer protocols for C2 communication

name: Ingress Tool Transfer
description: Transferring tools or files from an external system into the environment

name: Protocol Tunneling
description: Tunneling network communications through another protocol to avoid detection

name: Traffic Signaling
description: Using traffic signaling to hide open ports or trigger special behavior

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
description: Stealing data by sending it over the existing C2 communication channel

name: Network Denial of Service
description: Disrupting availability of services through network traffic flooding

name: Endpoint Denial of Service
description: Exhausting endpoint resources to deny availability

name: Data Encrypted for Impact
description: Encrypting data on target systems to disrupt availability (ransomware)

name: Data Manipulation
description: Modifying data to affect business processes or hide activity

name: Data Destruction
description: Destroying data and files on specific systems to disrupt operations

name: Defacement
description: Modifying visual content to intimidate or spread messaging

name: Resource Hijacking
description: Hijacking computing resources for cryptomining or other purposes

name: System Shutdown/Reboot
description: Shutting down or rebooting systems to disrupt access and operations

name: Firmware Corruption
description: Overwriting or corrupting firmware on devices to render them inoperable
